cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 names a national switch or retail clearing system the Bank of Algeria runs; the one source on oversight speaks of national payment and clearing systems in general.
cells.note: The Bank of Algeria authorised Djezzy Payment Services as a payment service provider in September 2026. An August 2025 report that PSPs must join the national payment and clearing systems it oversees names no switch or retail clearing system, so the switch rung is not met.
